states: Subscription pending_payment denies access and blocks duplicate signup

dataLifecycle: Shared invoice lock serializes repricing with collection and confirmation
Store recovery audit time and attempt schedule
Persisted service-period base subtotal remains the contracted base; tax/discount rules refresh at recovery time
Initial invoice and subscription created atomically; regular period endpoints align to day10 America/Sao_Paulo using whole-day proportional first period
Adjustment quote and invoice created atomically with upgrade; distinct adjustment identities coexist with unique regular period invoices
Confirmed paid quote remains immutable; degraded quote recovers current rules against original subtotal and stored region/coupon context
Upgrade payment deadline follows existing checkout TTL, capped by the current period end; no card decline is inferred from an outage or unsigned callback
failures: Repeated pricing outage leaves invoice blocked, with bounded retry backoff
Never reprice paid/terminal invoices or invoices with a payment intent/charge audit
Recovery commit before collection dispatch; existing due sweep recovers missed dispatches
acceptanceCriteria: Old totals remain until a nondegraded valid current quote is available
No duplicate collection or checkout creations across job retries
Backoff avoids re-hitting an unhealthy pricing dependency on every scrape/run
Existing synchronous fake and InfinitePay paths retain their invariants
Initial grant only on initial invoice settlement; adjustment cannot activate an unpaid period
First failure retains upgrade; retry exhaustion or unpaid deadline reverts once with audit
Quote ownership, stale period/from/to and duplicate consumption guarded
Late payment after a reverted upgrade reconciles without reapplying plan or duplicate audit

corrections.cause: Quote preservation originally bound only values, allowing a scheduled downgrade to be consumed as immediate or classification to change with catalogue pricing

corrections.prevention: Regressions for alternate downgrade mode and catalogue changes both during and after pricing

corrections.cause: Renewal publication while holding the subscription lock could trigger synchronous collection and recursive activation lock acquisition
corrections.fix: Create immutable queued renewal event under lock and publish after release; no collection in synchronous invoicing hooks
corrections.prevention: Trial conversion regression with real invoicing listener and immediate CollectInvoice execution
corrections.verification: Full PostgreSQL/Redis and SQLite financial tests passed

corrections.cause: Publication after state commit could leave pending first-payment subscription without invoice on queue/process failure
corrections.fix: Synchronous billing-period event creates the invoice inside the period transaction; collection sweep recovers missed post-commit dispatch
corrections.prevention: Injected post-commit publication failure verifies pending subscription still has initial invoice and collectible timestamp

corrections.cause: A shortened initial period cannot use full plan prices divided by only its shortened day count; UTC midnight could also shift the local remaining-day calculation
corrections.fix: Use the full anchored interval denominator and a consistent Sao Paulo timezone for anchored upgrade proration
corrections.prevention: Initial100->80 plus upgrade100->200 produces80 adjustment, including UTC-midnight/local-same-day regression
